requirement_source: Frozen defect-driven audit, 8 September 18:25 through 9 September 18:25 Israel, recorded in docs/acceptance.md; original ticket text governs.
activation: none; local source only; no CI or manifest consumer installed

scenarios.requirement: Operational backup observer must survive writer failure and detect silence.
scenarios.root_cause: Observer shared writer dependency and could vanish with the failed job.
scenarios.sibling_scope: Missing dependency, empty/stale/fresh bucket, transport failure and both jobs never starting; independent observer host.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Reader still distinguishes stale/missing from unavailable; separate deadline observation catches never-started jobs.
scenarios.mapping_status: pending actual normalized report IDs; file presence is not executed coverage
scenarios.negative_control: Restore the historical failure mechanism in disposable owned source, then introduce one held-out sibling variation; record changed-source and intended-assertion evidence.

scenarios.requirement: Allocation/certificate to stored document and QR verification; ownership/duplicates; restore and independent observation.
scenarios.root_cause: Historical incidents do not enumerate unseen business states or all current entry points.
scenarios.sibling_scope: Derive routes/controls/writers/roles/artifacts independently from product and schema; account for each member and meaningful state/configuration combinations.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Valid and refusal legs, cancel/reopen, second record/tenant, duplicate/stale/partial failure, phone/desktop; every excluded member has a stated reason.
scenarios.mapping_status: population enumeration and executable mappings pending

scenarios.requirement: Fast staging and comprehensive promotion with no ready work silently stranded.
scenarios.root_cause: Correct tests were omitted, skipped, run on another candidate, or green work never integrated.
scenarios.sibling_scope: All deploy triggers and required matrix members; local/remote work, runner queue/run deadlines and independent observer.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exact merged candidate, target, current attempt and fresh deployed proof; ready owner/deadline; missing evidence cannot authorize production.
scenarios.mapping_status: Existing release-gate implementation is separate; this full contract is not yet qualified
